metadata.question: Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji lower in December 2020 than December 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to compare NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) for Mount Fuji in December 2019 vs December 2020. NDSI is commonly calculated from Landsat or Sentinel-2 data using (Green - SWIR)/(Green + SWIR). 2. Data choice: Landsat 8 would be good for this since it has consistent Green and SWIR bands and good coverage. Sentinel-2 could be a backup. 3. Location: Mount Fuji coordinates approximately (35.3606°N, 138.7274°E). I'll create a point buffer around it. 4. Time periods: December 2019 (2019-12-01 to 2019-12-31) and December 2020 (2020-12-01 to 2020-12-31) 5. Processing: Calculate NDSI, mask clouds, compute mean NDSI for each period, compare. 6. Validation: Check collection sizes, valid pixel counts, and ensure NDSI values are in valid range (-1 to 1). Let me structure this: - Define geometry around Mount Fuji - Get Landsat 8 collections for both periods - Calculate NDSI = (B3 - B6)/(B3 + B6) for Landsat 8 - Mask clouds using the QA band - Compute mean NDSI for each period - Compare and answer if 2020 mean < 2019 mean ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mountFuji = ee.Geometry.Point([138.7274, 35.3606]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer const dec2019 = ['2019-12-01', '2019-12-31']; const dec2020 = ['2020-12-01', '2020-12-31']; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance const getL8Collection = (dateRange) => { return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(mountFuji) .filterDate(dateRange[0], dateRange[1]) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 80)); }; const col2019 = getL8Collection(dec2019); const col2020 = getL8Collection(dec2020); // Check collection sizes const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}, 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate NDSI and composite const calculateNDSI = (image) => { // Landsat 8: Green = B3, SWIR = B6 const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('NDSI'); // Cloud masking using QA_PIXEL band const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4)); // Cloud and cloud shadow return image.addBands(ndsi).updateMask(cloudMask.eq(0)); }; // Create median composites const composite2019 = col2019.map(calculateNDSI).median(); const composite2020 = col2020.map(calculateNDSI).median(); // 4. Calculate mean NDSI values const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }); const stats2019 = composite2019.select('NDSI').reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: mountFuji, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2020 = composite2020.select('NDSI').reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: mountFuji, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2019 = stats2019.NDSI_mean; const mean2020 = stats2020.NDSI_mean; const count2019 = stats2019.NDSI_count; const count2020 = stats2020.NDSI_count; console.log(`2019 Mean NDSI: ${mean2019?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count2019}`); console.log(`2020 Mean NDSI: ${mean2020?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count2020}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (mean2019 === null || mean2020 === null || Math.abs(mean2019) > 1 || Math.abs(mean2020) > 1) { console.log("C3"); } else if (mean2020 < mean2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
